hooks.name: skill-routing-gate
hooks.description: Appends a routing reminder to every user prompt so skill loading does not depend on skill auto-discovery. Policy lives in .kiro/steering/skill-routing.md.

action.prompt: [skill-routing gate] Before any other tool call or answer, apply .kiro/steering/skill-routing.md: classify this request, then call load_resource (skill::<name>) for every skill its routing table lists for that class. Phrases like "one message", "do not write files" or "no commands" limit your output, not skill loading: loading a skill is read-only. Start the reply with the Route line, listing every table skill you did not load with the reason. Subagents ignore this gate.
